name: Misaki Kaho
source:
Kaho works with dedication as a model since she was small. During her break, she takes her chance to stay in the island for a while. 

[Edited and some parts roughly translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/natsuuta/]official website[/url].]
